assertions.name: per_cell_weight_matches_alpha_em
assertions.source: Checks if the geometric per-cell coupling weight under τ_q matches the hypothesized α_em/π factor. If false, it hits the pre-stated failure signature.

description: Session A probe: applies τ_q action to ONE ideal octahedron at h² order under the Reading-A geometrised scaffold (PR #1628). Checks if the resulting per-cell coupling weight matches the hypothesized α_em/π factor (the Bring-zero-mode analog). Pre-stated failure signature: weight is a rational times G (Catalan's constant) without an α_em factor.
caveats: The probe hits the pre-stated failure signature: the per-cell weight from the non-abelian Stokes integration comes out as exactly G (Catalan's constant), not α_em/π. This means α_em is NOT the per-cell coupling and requires a different categorical input (e.g. the Bring-zero-mode analog is not directly injected via the standard τ_q connection). Session A result is NEGATIVE. Will proceed to reconsider the Bring-zero-mode analog assumption or defer to the co-simplicial crossed-groupoid structure.
